title: MUSS: A Multi-scale and Sequence-based Model for Single-cell Gene Regulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.08086v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modeling gene regulation in single cells requires jointly representing DNA sequence, chromatin accessibility, and gene expression across regulatory scales. Sequence-based models capture DNA-level regulatory grammar but often lack cell-level resolution, whereas many single-cell omics models represent genes and peaks as fixed-vocabulary tokens without their underlying sequence. Here, we present MUSS, a sequence-based multi-scale model for single-cell gene regulation that preserves both DNA-level and cell-level resolution. MUSS derives peak- and gene-level representations from DNA using a frozen pre-trained sequence encoder and integrates them through peak-peak self-attention and distance-biased peak-gene interactions. Peak masked language modeling followed by training on paired scATAC-seq and scRNA-seq aligns these representations with cell-specific regulatory states. translated_title: MUSS：一个面向单细胞基因调控的多尺度序列模型
translated_abstract: 对单细胞基因调控进行建模需要在多个调控尺度上联合表示DNA序列、染色质可及性和基因表达。基于序列的模型能够捕捉DNA水平的调控语法，但通常缺乏细胞水平的分辨率；而许多单细胞组学模型将基因和峰表示为固定词表的token，却不包含其底层的DNA序列信息。本文提出MUSS，一个基于序列的多尺度单细胞基因调控模型，它同时保留了DNA水平和细胞水平的分辨率。MUSS利用一个冻结的预训练序列编码器从DNA中提取峰级和基因级表示，并通过峰-峰自注意力和距离偏置的峰-基因交互将它们整合起来。先进行峰值掩码语言建模，再在配对的scATAC-seq和scRNA-seq数据上训练，使这些表示与细胞特异性的调控状态对齐。在基因表达预测、增强子-基因关联、基序引导的（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: MUSS是一个基于序列的多尺度单细胞基因调控模型，利用冻结的预训练DNA序列编码器提取峰级与基因级表示，并通过峰-峰自注意力和距离偏置的峰-基因交互进行整合，在保留DNA序列信息的同时实现细胞水平的基因调控建模。
